transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess the clinic doctor was concerned about how little I eat. Most days it’s just coffee in the morning, maybe a few bites of something between jobs, and a small dinner if I’m not too busy with class paperwork.
Are you trying to eat less because you’re worried about gaining weight?

Yeah. If I eat something heavy—like pizza or a big sandwich—I get panicky that I’ll wake up bigger and slower. I need to be able to move around ladders and through rooms for work, and it feels like eating that kind of food could mess that up.
Do you feel fat even when other people tell you that you’re thin?
I don’t really see myself as fat. I just don’t think my weight is some emergency like everyone keeps saying. It feels like they’re making a big deal out of me being disciplined and busy.
Has your weight dropped so low that a doctor has told you that you’re underweight?
No doctor has said it outright. My work pants are pretty loose now, and people on job sites say I look too thin, but I just see it as leaning out from being on my feet all day.
What is your current weight?
I don’t know the exact number. My work pants are hanging pretty loose, and people keep saying I look too thin, but I think I’ve just leaned out from being on my feet all day.
Do you know your height?
I’m not sure of the exact height. I just know my pants have gotten really loose, and people at work keep saying I look too thin. I think I’ve just leaned out from being on my feet all day.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yeah. If I eat something heavy, like pizza or a big sandwich, I get kind of panicky that I’ll wake up bigger and slower. I need to be able to move around ladders and rooms at work.
Has anyone told you that your weight is dangerously low?
People have said they’re worried, yeah, but I don’t think it’s an emergency. It feels like they’re making a big deal out of me being disciplined and busy.
Has a clinician ever told you that your weight was below what is considered healthy for your height?
No clinician has told me that exactly. People at job sites say I look too thin, and my work pants are really loose, but I’ve thought it was just from being on my feet all day.
Have you had a recent weight measurement on a scale?

I haven’t weighed myself recently. I just know my work pants are hanging really loose, and people at job sites keep saying I look too thin. But I figured I’ve just leaned out from being on my feet all day.
What is your weight right now?

I don’t know my exact weight right now—I haven’t been on a scale. My work pants are hanging pretty loose, and people keep saying I look too thin, but I figured I’ve just leaned out from being on my feet all day.
Would you be willing to step on a scale today so we can see your current weight?
I guess so, if you need me to. I don’t really think it’s a big issue—I’ve just leaned out from being on my feet at work—but my pants have gotten pretty loose.
What did the scale say when you were weighed today?
I didn’t really catch the number. I just know my pants have been hanging loose, and people at work say I look too thin. I figured it was from being on my feet all day.
When you look at your body, do you believe you are overweight?

I don’t know if I’d say overweight, but if I eat something heavy—like pizza or a big sandwich—I get panicky that I’ll wake up bigger and slower. I need to be able to move around ladders and rooms at work.
Has anyone told you that your current weight is below the healthy range for your height?
People at the job sites keep saying I look too thin, and my work pants are really loose now. But I’ve mostly thought I just leaned out from being on my feet all day.
Has a clinician told you that your current weight is below the healthy range for your height?
No, not directly. People at work say I look too thin, and my pants are loose, but I figured I’d just leaned out from being on my feet all day.
What was your weight the last time you knew the number?

I haven’t checked an actual number recently. I just know my work pants are hanging really loose, and people on job sites say I look too thin. I figured I’d just leaned out from being on my feet all day.
Do you know whether your current weight is below the healthy range for your height?
I don’t really know for sure. My pants are a lot looser and people keep commenting that I look too thin, but I’ve been thinking it’s just from being on my feet working all day.
Have you ever made yourself vomit after eating?
No, I haven’t made myself throw up after eating.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I eat regular meals sometimes, but not a huge amount all at once.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has markedly restricted food intake and fear of weight gain with minimization of the seriousness of low weight, suggesting an eating disorder. However, the interview did not establish the key ICD-10 requirement for anorexia nervosa of significantly low body weight (e.g., objective weight/BMI threshold), so anorexia nervosa could not be confirmed. There is also no evidence of binge eating or purging. Therefore, the most accurate diagnosis from the available information is unspecified eating disorder.
